name: notifications-operations
title: Notification Operations
description: Compatibility exports of @krak-stack/notifications-admin/operations and /deliveries. Import its Tailwind stylesheet and share the registry KrakstackProvider. Hosts own authorization and localized messages.
docs: Mount NotificationOperations behind the host admin guard. Use @krak-stack/notifications/admin and its table endpoints for authorized data. Pass tableState, onTableStateChange, and the authoritative total to use KrakStack search, filters, sorting and pagination. NotificationDeliveries adds opt-in, read-only overview, activity and attempt inspection for existing engine-published product emails. Mount admin/delivery.api with separate DeliveryAdmin middleware and explicit host scope grants; SendAdmin alone never grants product-email access. No republishing or synthetic contacts are needed. Feedback coverage is explicitly distinguished from delivery acceptance. Suppression removal requires the exact reviewed version and an audit reason; it never restores consent or resends mail. See src/agent-examples/send/console.tsx for the unified NotificationsAdminPanel. Package export: @krak-stack/registry/notifications/operations.
